name: VaultDoorFace
shape_prompt: Stylized 3D game prop, chunky vinyl-toy style, smooth sculpted rounded forms, quirky proportions. A thick round vault door disc, like a giant coin, its front face shaped like a clock face with twelve raised hour dots, two raised clock hands as the dial and a round knob in the centre, chunky rounded rim. Front view, single object, no base.
texture_prompt: Bright saturated colours, smooth soft vinyl-toy finish, clean hand-painted look. Cream clock face, dark brown hour dots and clock hands, shiny gold centre knob, steel-blue rim. No text, no logos.
